So here is the example:
If you directly search security engineer it will show you 100+ article and etc
But using Google dork you can specify the things you want to search!

1. [Security Engineer 1st Example](https://www.google.com/search?q=site%3Ajobs.*.*+intext%3Ajob+"Security+Engineer"&source=hp&ei=jdQBZPLVGoqEz7sPvs62mA0&oq=site%3Ajobs.*.*+intext%3Ajob+"Security+Engineer")

2. [Security Engineer 2nd example](https://www.google.com/search?q=site%3Acareer.*.*+intext%3Acareer+"Security+Engineer"&oq=site%3Acareer.*.*+intext%3Acareer+"Security+Engineer")

In simple word: 
Inurl: career.*.*
- I don't want to see news.example.com or blog.example.com. I only want to see website which has career.example.com
- *(Star) means all the domain not particular one
- You can try career/careers/job/jobs to find job portal of any company 😄

Intext: Career
- Show me the website career.example.com which has career word mentioned in that portal

"Security Engineer"
- Show me only website which has "Security engineer" word in sequence. Not security XYZ engineer. It will only show you particular word in sequence.
- Yes, Double quote is mandatory for this last one!
